description: x402 Listing Check: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it. Seller-side preflight check: is the endpoint payable by a default x402 client? Fetches it, reads the 402 challenge, verifies accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), checks the input example for placeholders, and measures the challenge against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use before listing a new API, or when a buyer reports it broken.
name: x402-listing-check
